database_findings.impact: Winning a Whis Arena match before getRewards() loads existing rewards from DB permanently wipes all previously stored unclaimed rewards in whis_arena_rewards.
database_findings.root_cause: addReward() uses pendingArenaRewards.computeIfAbsent(playerId, k -> new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>()) without loading from DB first, and saveRewardsToDB() executes ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rewards = ? overwriting the DB JSON array.
database_findings.title: WhisArenaService.addReward overwrites uncached DB rewards on cold cache

database_findings.impact: Crash during Sunday reset can cause double weekly gem payouts, stale arenaWins persistence on logout, or corrupted vdst_weekly.json losing unclaimed records.
database_findings.root_cause: rewardAndReset() performs SELECT, gem payout + PlayerDAO.updatePlayer, UPDATE player SET arena_wins = 0, RAM reset, and FileWriter saveData() without a DB transaction or atomic file write; RAM reset happens after SQL UPDATE.
database_findings.title: Non-atomic weekly VDST reset and non-atomic JSON persistence

database_findings.impact: New players fail to initialize achievement entries (swallowed ClassCastException) and players created via createPlAo or with null JSON columns fail to load at login.
database_findings.root_cause: createNewPlayer inserts integer 0 for data_achievement and giftcode which JSONValue.parse parses as Long (causing ClassCastException when cast to JSONArray), and loadPlayer parses several columns with raw `(JSONArray) JSONValue.parse(...)` without null checks.
database_findings.title: Unchecked JSONArray casts in NDVSqlFetcher.loadPlayer and invalid scalar '0' defaults in PlayerDAO.createNewPlayer

database_findings.impact: Violates JDBC try-with-resources invariant; leaves PreparedStatement/ResultSet open until Connection returns/closes or garbage collection, risking statement/cursor leaks under load.
database_findings.root_cause: EventDAO and PlayerDAO.subvnd/subVND2 open PreparedStatement (and ResultSet in EventDAO) outside try-with-resources; EventDAO and subVND2 never close ps/rs explicitly.
database_findings.title: PreparedStatement and ResultSet not managed with try-with-resources in EventDAO and PlayerDAO.subvnd/subVND2

database_findings.impact: Causes N+1 redundant queries on server startup/reload and wastes DB roundtrips on tab_shop.
database_findings.root_cause: loadShopTab runs `SELECT * FROM tab_shop WHERE shop_id = ?`, then for every tab calls loadItemShop which executes `SELECT * FROM tab_shop WHERE tab_index = ? AND shop_id = ?` on the exact same table/row instead of reading the `items` column directly.
database_findings.title: Redundant N+1 queries re-fetching tab_shop for every tab in ShopDAO

database_findings.impact: Concurrent SuperRank first-time initializations can assign duplicate ranks; concurrent BlackBall rewards can drop a star update; high stats (>2.14B) truncate in SuperRank display.
database_findings.root_cause: SuperRankDAO.loadData computes getCurrentHighestRank() + 1 outside a lock/transaction, and readData casts Long hp/dame/def to intValue(). PlayerDAO.updateBlackBallReward does SELECT then UPDATE without FOR UPDATE.
database_findings.title: Non-atomic read-modify-write in SuperRankDAO/updateBlackBallReward and int truncation in SuperRankDAO.readData

database_findings.impact: Transaction audit errors and JSON parse errors are silently dropped; goldP1/goldP2 use int instead of long and gold1Before/After/gold2Before/After are never persisted.
database_findings.root_cause: Empty catch blocks swallow exceptions in HistoryTransactionDAO.insert, SuperRankDAO, and NDVSqlFetcher; HistoryTransactionDAO.insert uses += string concat in loops and ignores gold before/after args.
database_findings.title: Swallowed SQL/JSON exceptions and unused/int-typed gold parameters in HistoryTransactionDAO and SuperRankDAO

database_findings.impact: Any SQL query using column aliases (e.g., SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt) or computed expressions fails lookup by alias name via get*(String) and may return 0/null or overwrite keys.
database_findings.root_cause: ResultSetImpl constructor calls rsmd.getColumnName(j) instead of rsmd.getColumnLabel(j) when populating rowMap keys.
database_findings.title: getColumnName used instead of getColumnLabel breaks SQL aliases

database_findings.impact: Calling getTimestamp() on a DATETIME column in MySQL Connector/J 8.x throws Exception("Cannot convert LocalDateTime to Timestamp") at runtime.
database_findings.root_cause: Constructor extracts column values via rs.getObject(j) (which returns java.time.LocalDateTime for DATETIME in MySQL 8.x), while getTimestamp(int/String) only handles Timestamp, java.util.Date, and Long.
database_findings.title: getTimestamp fails on MySQL 8.x LocalDateTime from rs.getObject

database_findings.impact: Consigned items, purchases, or cancellations can be lost, resurrected, or fail with duplicate key errors during periodic save().
database_findings.root_cause: save() deletes all rows from shop_ky_gui and re-inserts a snapshot under saveLock, while async Virtual Thread methods (updateItemBoughtAsync, deleteItemAsync, updateItemUpTopAsync, insertItemAsync) execute concurrent SQL writes without acquiring saveLock. Also save() skips deleting DB rows when itemsToSave is empty.
database_findings.title: Race condition and data loss between ConsignShopManager.save() and async Virtual Thread DB writes

database_findings.impact: Exhausts HikariCP database connection pool under player rename attempts.
database_findings.root_cause: AlyraManager.executeQuery("select * from player where name = ?", text[0]).next() discards the returned AlyraResultSet without closing/disposing it.
database_findings.title: Unclosed AlyraResultSet Connection Leak in Input.CHANGE_NAME & CHANGE_NAME_BY_ITEM

database_findings.impact: Namek dragon wish stalls Netty thread with up to ~50 blocking DB roundtrips and risks ConcurrentModificationException and offline login overwrite races; MuaCtService mismatches ruby/gem pricing and credits offline/unlocked sellers.
database_findings.root_cause: SummonDragonNamek iterates clan.members synchronously calling NDVSqlFetcher.loadById and PlayerDAO.updatePlayer per offline member. MuaCtService previews price with getRubyPrice() but charges/matches COST_GEM and credits seller.inventory.gem without verifying online status or locking seller/buyer.
database_findings.title: Blocking N+1 DB Loop in SummonDragonNamek & Price/Lock Mismatch in MuaCtService

database_findings.impact: TOP Sức Mạnh leaderboard fails to exclude admin accounts whose account.id != player.id and wrongly excludes normal players whose player.id happens to match an admin's account.id.
database_findings.root_cause: queryTopSM joins `LEFT JOIN account a ON p.id = a.id AND a.is_admin = 1` instead of joining on `p.account_id = a.id`.

database_findings.impact: JDBC `Statement` is leaked on every run, and `Connection` is leaked if `RedRibbonHQService` or any statement throws an exception.
database_findings.root_cause: `DriverManager.getConnection(...)` and `conn.createStatement()` are not wrapped in `try-with-resources`; `stmt` is unused and never closed, and `conn.close()` is outside `finally`.
database_findings.title: Resource leak in TestMobParse (missing try-with-resources)
